## Checklist

- [ ] Branch follows `<type>/<description>`.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, credentials, or `.env` files are included.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Tests cover the change (parser, pagination, layout, exports where relevant).
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated for user-visible changes.
- [ ] README or docs updated if behavior changed.
- [ ] No new runtime dependency without justification.
- [ ] No network calls, telemetry, or storage beyond `localStorage`.
